chapterPurpose: ‘What a Tank!’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects water storage, traditional tanks and local knowledge, rainwater harvesting, community responsibility, water conservation. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
